description: This source file contains a function to check the extension of model files used in ImageAI, ensuring compatibility with the underlying framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow). It raises errors if incompatible model files or unsupported extensions are provided.

methods.name: extension_check(file_path: str)
methods.description: Checks the file extension of a model file and raises errors if the model file is incompatible or has an unsupported extension.
